content.stem: 犯罪分子可能会滥用由会计师编制的财务报表来隐藏非法资产。以下哪种情形最有可能导致犯罪分子操纵财务报表？

options.A: 审计人员在审查财务报表时忽视明显财务差异，使可疑活动被隐藏
options.B: 犯罪分子假扮成寻求财务建议的个人，将资产转移至难以触及之处，以逃避未来可能承担的责任
options.C: 记账时提供的记录不完整，导致难以审计
options.D: 会计师被用作中间人，将犯罪分子介绍给金融机构

content.stem_en: Criminals may misuse financial statements prepared by accountants to hide illicit assets. Which of the following scenarios poses the greatest risk of financial statement manipulation by criminals?

options_en.A: Auditors overlook clear financial discrepancies when reviewing financial statements, allowing suspicious activity to be concealed
options_en.B: Criminals posing as individuals seeking financial advice to place assets out of reach to avoid future liabilities
options_en.C: Incomplete records being provided during bookkeeping, making them difficult to audit
options_en.D: Accountants being used as intermediaries to introduce criminals to financial institutions
